title: Yayasan Sabah Scholarship / Loan / Financial Aid 2026
description: Financial support by Yayasan Sabah covering scholarships, financial aid (dermasiswa), and study loans for Certificate to PhD levels at local and selected international institutions.
eligibility: Malaysian citizens with Sabah connection (applicant and/or at least one parent from Sabah). Priority for applicants born and residing in Sabah. Specific schemes require minimum SPM results or CGPA.

title: PMG Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship by PMG Healthcare Group for Malaysian students pursuing Pharmacy or Radiography degrees, offering financial support, career development, and guaranteed job placement after graduation.
eligibility: Malaysian citizens pursuing a full-time Degree in Pharmacy or Radiography (Foundation to Year 4) at recognised Malaysian institutions. Must have minimum CGPA 3.00/4.00 and not hold other scholarships (except education loans like PTPTN, MARA, JPA).

title: YTL Foundation Scholarship Programme 2026
description: Prestigious Malaysian scholarship by YTL Foundation covering full undergraduate studies locally, with comprehensive support including tuition, living expenses, internships, and career development.
eligibility: Malaysian citizens pursuing a full-time undergraduate degree. Must demonstrate strong academic results (e.g. SPM ≥ 7As, Foundation CGPA ≥ 3.7), leadership potential, community involvement, and financial need.

title: OCBC Public Scholarship Programme 2026
description: OCBC Public Scholarship supports Malaysian students pursuing full-time undergraduate studies at recognised public or private universities in Malaysia. It provides financial assistance for tuition fees and living expenses, along with internship opportunities at OCBC Bank for real-world banking experience and career development.
eligibility: Malaysian citizens who have gained admission or are eligible for admission into full-time undergraduate studies at recognised Malaysian universities. Applicants must have excellent STPM or Matriculation results, strong co-curricular involvement, leadership qualities, and strong communication and critical thinking skills. Applicants must not be receiving other scholarships or awards.

title: UOW Malaysia Excellence Award Scholarship
description: The most prestigious scholarship offered at UOW Malaysia, providing a full tuition fee waiver for the duration of study. Each year, only a small number of high-achieving students are selected. It is available for Pre-University, Foundation, Diploma, and Bachelor’s Degree programmes at UOW Malaysia.
eligibility: Applicants must be new students at UOW Malaysia (2025 intakes) and must have paid the full enrolment fee. Eligibility is based on outstanding academic results only (SPM ≥ 9A+; O-Level ≥ 9A*; A-Level ≥ 19 points/AAAB; STPM CGPA ≥ 3.75 for 3–4 subjects; UEC aggregate ≤ 8 for 5 subjects; SAM/AUSMAT ATAR ≥ 90; CPU ≥ 95%; IB ≥ 40; Foundation/Diploma CGPA ≥ 3.90). Applicants must also demonstrate strong leadership qualities, self-motivation, and positive attributes.

title: Biasiswa Siswi SAFI 2026
description: Biasiswa Siswi SAFI is a scholarship designed to support bright and exceptional Malaysian female students pursuing full-time undergraduate studies at selected IPTA universities in Malaysia. It provides tuition fee support and semester-based allowance to help students complete their studies, while encouraging leadership, aspiration, and community involvement.
eligibility: Malaysian female students aged 18–25 with valid MyKad/MyPR. Must be enrolled full-time in an IPTA listed on the official website. Applicants must have CGPA ≥ 3.0, demonstrate leadership and aspirational qualities, active participation in co-curricular or community activities, and belong to a household with monthly net income below RM10,000. Applicants must also have no disciplinary record, suspensions, or ongoing investigations.

title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) 2026
description: The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) is a fully funded programme by the Korean government that supports international students to pursue Master’s and PhD studies at top universities in South Korea. It aims to promote international educational exchange and cooperation, covering tuition fees, airfare, living allowance, health insurance, and research support.
eligibility: Open to applicants from selected countries (including 105 ODA recipient countries). Applicants must meet one of the academic requirements: CGPA ≥ 80/100, or rank within top 20% of class, or CGPA ≥ 2.64/4.0, 2.80/4.3, 2.91/4.5, or 3.23/5.0. Applicants must be under 40 years old (born after 1 September 1984). Academic professors from ODA recipient countries may apply if under 45 years old (born after 1 September 1979). Applicants must be in good physical and mental health.

title: YYC & Co PLT Company Secretary Internship (Corporate & Business Admin)
description: Internship programme at YYC & Co PLT in Kuala Lumpur focusing on company secretarial and corporate administration work. Interns will assist with statutory compliance, corporate exercises, board meeting coordination, documentation, and filing of statutory records under supervision.
eligibility: Candidates currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Business Studies, Administration, Management, Secretarial studies, or equivalent. Applicants should be self-motivated, proactive, and have strong communication skills. Good teamwork attitude required. Must be willing to work in Cheras, Kuala Lumpur. Mandarin and English proficiency required.

title: Watsons Malaysia Internship Programme 2026 (TRX, Kuala Lumpur)
description: Internship programme at Watsons Malaysia offering hands-on experience across multiple business functions including HR, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, IT, Sales Operations, Internal Audit, and E-commerce. Interns will work in a fast-paced retail and consumer business environment at the Tun Razak Exchange (TRX), Kuala Lumpur, gaining real-world exposure and potential career pathways within the company.
eligibility: Students currently pursuing a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in relevant fields such as Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance/Accounting, E-commerce, Computer Science/AI, or HR/Psychology. Applicants must have a minimum CGPA of 3.00, be available for 3–6 months internship duration, and be proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Strong communication skills, adaptability, and teamwork are required.

title: Experian Malaysia Software Engineer Internship (2026)
description: Software Engineer internship at Experian Malaysia offering hands-on experience in full stack development within a global information services company. Interns will work with experienced engineers on real-world projects involving coding, testing, CI/CD pipelines, Agile development, and software design at the Mid Valley City office (hybrid).
eligibility: Students currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields. Applicants should have a basic understanding of software development principles, familiarity with programming languages such as Java, Python, Bash script, or Groovy, and knowledge of Git version control. Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills are required. Eagerness to learn new technologies is essential.
